analysis.title: Johnson Controls International Plc (JCI): Orders re-accelerating, FY27 guide is conservative
key_insights: F4Q26 segment EBITA was +3% vs FactSet consensus, driven by stronger sales and margins than expected in Americas.
Orders re-accelerated to +44% organically y/y (vs +27% organically in F3Q26), with backlog of $23.0bn up 43% y/y. Growth continues to be driven by systems.
Management expects 70%-80% of the $23bn backlog to convert over the next 12 months.
Within Data Centers, chillers remain the largest offering, but a growing share of growth comes from CDUs, cold plates and modular, which expands JCI's TAM per MW.

Management plans about $900mn of capex in FY27 versus about $465mn in FY26, to add capacity for rising demand. Management said it would have been 2x this number without productivity and capital efficiency initiatives.
FY27 EPS guide is $6.15-6.30 on organic growth of +11-12%, operating leverage of about 30% and adjusted FCF conversion of about 95%. F1Q27 EPS guide is $1.15-1.20.
GS expects the guide to prove conservative on both organic growth and operating leverage, given re-accelerating orders and continued self-help opportunity.
GS keeps FY27/FY28 EPS estimates unchanged at $6.50/$8.00 and introduces an FY29 EPS estimate of $9.35.

GS stays Buy and keeps JCI on the Conviction list. The 12-month price target rises to $196 from $191 as Q5-Q8 EBITDA estimates roll forward. The target is based on 19.0x Q5-Q8 EBITDA and implies about a 4.0% FY28E FCF yield.

market_movers.rationale: PT raised to $196 from $191 as Q5-Q8 EBITDA estimates roll forward, on 19.0x EBITDA. Rating is Buy and on the Conviction list. Upside from $155.88 is 25.7%.

earnings_insights: F4Q26 adj. EPS reported $1.66 vs consensus $1.59. Organic growth was +12%: Americas +14%, EMEA +3%, Asia Pacific +13%.
F4Q26 segment EBITA was +3% vs FactSet consensus.
FY27 EPS guidance of $6.15-6.30, set against consensus of $6.12 in one passage and $6.16 in another. GS FY27 EPS estimate is $6.50.
F1Q27 EPS guidance is $1.15-1.20 (mid-point about $1.18), vs consensus est $1.13. GS F1Q27 EPS estimate is $1.22.
GS EPS estimates: FY27 $6.50, FY28 $8.00, FY29 $9.35. FY26 EPS was $5.24 (diluted, pre-exceptionals).
